title: The Sculpture of Living Forms at Khirbat al Mafjar
author: R. W. Hamilton
location_note: Kh. al Mafjar (Umayyad palace and baths) north of Jericho; no map reference; placed by name.
reading: pp. 100-101 in full; then eligible-class keyword paragraphs
notes: Study of carved gypsum-plaster figures from the palace entrance hall and the bath complex (twelve seasons to 1948). Statue niches are architectural; the baths are named as a findspot only. No eligible feature.
